response.original_title: Tayki and the three magical drops
response.overview: A story of sweat, blood, and tears  Princess Tayki will give all everything to save her father and free her city from Alexandros's grip. Alongside her cousin Adora and a friend found along the way, she searches far and wide for the one thing that can end the suffering, only to discover the answer was never far from home.
